facts.fact: Winter 拒认赢局：再办一场、须独自赢
facts.anchor: We’ll have another game and you’ll need to win. On your own.

facts.fact: 权力宣言：我说你错就是你的错
facts.anchor: “It’s your fault if I say it’s your fault.”

facts.fact: Micah 要求照样杀——Winter 用下一场游戏否决
facts.anchor: She’ll entertain us with another game soon.

facts.fact: 她从没杀过人类同类；四个死者皆为弟弟
facts.anchor: She’d grown used to murdering wolves, but never had she killed her own kind

facts.fact: 晕倒在庄园地板——伤口比想的开裂
facts.anchor: Sterling couldn’t physically hold back any longer and stumbled forward before collapsing to the floor

facts.fact: 公主抱上楼；Would you rather crawl up the stairs?
facts.anchor: Winter’s strong arms lifted her, pressing her against his firm chest

facts.fact: 母亲非贵族出身、教他自理伤口——亲手缝针
facts.anchor: “My mother wasn’t born royalty. She taught me how to take care of my own wounds.”

facts.fact: Sterling 推想女王善待村庄源于平民出身记忆
facts.anchor: the queen had always been kind to the human villages, recalling what it was like to be without wealth

facts.fact: 承诺：赢下场允许见弟弟，乖就给纸
facts.anchor: Win the next game and I’ll allow you a moment with your brother before freeing him

facts.fact: 谈 Talia 时他眼里只有 rage 没有 pain
facts.anchor: Pain wasn’t in his eyes, only rage swirling in their depths

facts.fact: 毛巾出场他饥渴扫视——她竟不全反感
facts.anchor: His gaze darkened and hungrily swept down her body as her heart thundered. And why wasn’t she wholly loathing it?
